_comment: nmap's own device types (the d/ field of its service signatures, the devicetype attribute of <service> in its XML): a fixed vocabulary of nmap, no brand. Each one -> the group of the page and, when it is clear, the finer kind of data/device_kinds.json. Counted only when nmap really probed the service (method=probed), once per device. Types that say too little are left out on purpose (general purpose, specialized, remote management, security-misc, power-device, terminal server, telecom-misc, PBX, VoIP adapter, proxy server, load balancer). storage-misc is in: nmap uses it for network storage.
